items.item_text: Driver's License:
Must possess California Driver License and participate in DMV Pull Notice program. Must be available for on-call assignments or alternate work schedule. Must be willing to work weekends.
Required to hold a valid drivers license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program.

1-3 yearsexperience installing, repairing, maintaining, and troubleshooting manual and automatic irrigation systems and related equipment.

Under supervision, performs and directs others in repairing, maintaining and installing both manual and automatic irrigated systems and related equipment, including but not limited to hydraulic and electrically operated irrigation controllers. Inspects systems, repairs and adjusts controllers, automatic and manual valves and complex sprinkler head. Knowledge of MaxiCom central control system.
Must be able to consistently perform job duties.
Knowledge of irrigation systems, both manual and automatic.
Ability to work under minimal supervision.
Knowledge and skill to operate commonly used grounds equipment and tools.
Ability to understand Departmental and U.C.I. policies and procedures.
Demonstrated ability and skill to repair, install and maintain irrigation systems.
Ability to develop short and medium range irrigation development and design plans.
Skill in operating trenchers, tractors, roto-tillers and other commonly used larger pieces of power driven grounds equipment.
Ability and skill to check own work/documentation for completion and accuracy of data.
Knowledge and ability to determine material requirements and estimate project costs.
Knowledge and ability to coordinate preventive maintenance programs.
Ability to be flexible and constantly adjust to changing priorities.
Ability to understand and apply University and departmental policies and procedures.
Ability to follow through and carry out assignments.
Problem-solving skills and sound judgement.
Ability to effectively communicate orally, in writing and electronically.
